content_sections.heading: KUDSIT Project Intern at a Glance

rows.details: Kerala University of Digital Sciences Innovation and Technology

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The recruitment notification announces a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Project Intern under the Social Engagement Centre of the University.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the essential educational qualifications, experience, and age requirements specified in the notification. Essential Educational Qualification: Master’s degree in Social Science/Humanities, preferably Sociology/Social Work with first class from a recognized Institution/University. Essential Experience and Skills: Experience in working with communities, at least while pursuing the postgraduate program; strong written and verbal communication skills in Malayalam and English; self-driven and motivated; good interpersonal skills; ability to work in terms; familiarity with Office software applications. Desirable Experience: Exposure to research methodologies; experience in research work/funded projects. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated pay of Rs. 12,000/- per month. The appointment is made on a contract basis for an initial period of 1 year, which includes a three months' probation period. The engagement may be extended based on performance and project requirements.

content_sections.heading: KUDSIT Project Intern Job Description and What SEC Offers
content_sections.text: The Social Engagement Centre offers interns exposure to research methodologies and experience in research work/funded projects.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection of candidates will be based on a test and/or Interview. The test or interview will be conducted in Thiruvananthapuram district only. Candidates will be intimated about the schedule through their registered email.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KUDSIT Project Intern
content_sections.text: Visit the official career portal at https://www.duk.ac.in/careers to access the application form. Fill out the online application completely, ensuring all mandatory fields are provided. Upload scanned copies of all required documents to prove age, qualifications, and experience. Submit the online application on or before the last date, which is 28.10.2026.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Scanned copy of documents to prove age Scanned copy of educational qualification certificates Scanned copy of experience certificates Other relevant supporting documents

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications submitted without attaching the required documents shall be summarily rejected without any further chance. Incomplete applications or applications without filling relevant fields will be rejected. Candidates must ensure all furnished particulars are correct; any suppression of material fact will lead to cancellation of candidature or termination of service. Canvassing in any form will entail the cancellation of candidature. Original documents must be produced as and when called for by the University.
